address: Four Seasons Resort Dubai Hotel, Jumeirah Beach Road, Jumeirah 2, Dubai
bio: Watching the sun set from a table on the sumptuous terrace of this delightful and elegant beachfront restaurant, you feel the stresses of the day fade away; endearing service from keen staff also helps to ensure an extra-special dining experience. Vibrant, Asian-influenced seafood dishes are fresh and full of flavour. The sashimi, maki and nigiri selection, as well their tempura and wok-fried dishes showcase their strong Japanese techniques....
